action.summary: To get $x^3$ and $\frac1{x^3}$, we cube $x+\frac1x$: $$-125=(-5)^3=\left(x+\frac1x\right)^3=x^3+3x+\frac3x+\frac1{x^3}$$ by the Binomial Theorem.
